kept.excerpt: China’s cyberspace regulator said on Wednesday that Apple’s on-device generative AI service, Apple Intelligence, has been registered for use on iPhones in China, paving the way for the long-anticipated rollout of the service in the country. Alibaba said in a statement to Reuters that its Qwen model will be integrated into Apple Intelligence across Apple’s iPhone (iOS), iPad (iPadOS), Mac (macOS) and Vision Pro (visionOS) operating systems in China.
kept.relevance: Identifies a recent regulatory catalyst for Apple's AI rollout in a major market that could influence its valuation before July 31.
